profile.summary: We Lead Ours is a nonprofit that has served Bay Area youth since 2010. It offers mentorship, sports, education and life skills programs, including internships, community tennis, football and cheer, and behavioral health support. It also works with Oakland schools through coaching, classroom presentations and workshops.
